explanation: Breadth-first search dictionary words reachable by one lowercase substitution. Remove each word from a copied unvisited set when queued; its first reached distance is shortest, and the input dictionary stays unchanged.
timeComplexity: O(M + 26VL²) expected for dictionary size M, V visited words and word length L
spaceComplexity: O(M+VL) auxiliary references and generated queued strings
